parameters.goalies: starts including pulled starts; relief separate

limitations: No slate salaries, verified DK eligibility or slate alignment are created by this recipe.
Playing/start probability, current lines, PP roles and injury status remain separate inputs.
SH points, shootout goals and missing goalie offensive events remain unknown; outputs are partial DK scores.
Identity seed fixes the included player cohort and current-team labels; refresh and independently verify the seed before adding new players or team changes.
Fixed 2025-2027 season window; a new season requires an explicit reviewed recipe/builder update.
No scheduled refresh, account persistence, AI cloud refresh endpoint or automatic production deployment.
Historical SD and quantiles are descriptive, not calibrated forecast certainty.
